description: Hobby+ endpoint. Registers PLACED bets (singles or parlays) so PropLine holds them and settles each when its games are graded. Same bet fields as propline_settle_bets. Use this instead of propline_settle_bets when the game has NOT been played yet and the user wants the result later; read it back with propline_list_tracked_bets. Give each bet a ref: sending the same ref again returns the bet already held, so a retry never duplicates. Each bet comes back with bet_id and status: 'open' (held), 'settled' (the game was already graded) or 'rejected' with a reason (not stored: surface it). Streaming Lite and above also get a bet_settled webhook, and bet_regraded if an official stat correction changes the result. The response carries open_bets and open_bet_limit (Hobby/Pro 500). This stores data on the user's account: only call it when the user asked to track or save a bet.

bets.description: Bets to track. A single bet uses the leg fields directly; a parlay sets legs.

bookmaker.description: Optional book the bet was placed at.

legs.description: Parlay legs; each has the single-bet fields above.

period.description: Canonical period code (q1, h1, f5). Omit for full game.

price.description: American odds taken. Needed for payout.

ref.description: Your id for the bet; makes retries safe.

selection.description: Player for a prop, team for a game line, 'Over'/'Under' for a game total.

team.description: Scope a totals bet to one team's total.
